map.算法：围护结构负荷 = 面积×朝向系数（北向 80、东/西向 120、南向 15: Algorithm: envelope load = area × orientation factor (north 80, east/west 120, south 150, southwest 200 W/m²); occupant load = people × 130 W; equipment load = equipment power × 0.8 (simultaneous use factor); lighting load = lighting power × 0.9...
map.按面积、朝向、人数与发热设备逐项计算冷负荷: Compute cooling load item by item from area, orientation, occupants and heat-producing equipment
map.把总冷负荷折算为空调匹数与制冷量: Convert total cooling load into air-conditioner unit size and cooling capacity
map.输出各项负荷占比，辅助节能诊断: Output the share of each load item to support energy diagnosis
map.家用/办公室选型：按面积、朝向、人数与发热设备算总冷负荷: Home / office selection: compute total cooling load from area, orientation, occupants and heat-producing equipment
map.匹数匹配：把总负荷折算成空调匹数，避免选大或选小: Unit-size matching: convert total load into air-conditioner unit size to avoid choosing too large or too small
map.节能诊断：看清各项负荷占比，找主要热源: Energy diagnosis: see the share of each load item and find the main heat source
map.输入房间面积、层高与朝向: Enter room area, ceiling height and orientation
map.输入人数与发热设备功率: Enter the number of occupants and heat-producing equipment power
map.设置换气次数与围护负荷指标: Set air change rate and envelope load index
map.点击计算，读取总冷负荷与推荐匹数: Click calculate and read the total cooling load and recommended unit size
map.查看各项负荷占比，定位主要热源: View the share of each load item to locate the main heat source
map.住宅单位负荷约 80~120W/m²、办公室 120~180W/m²，设备密集或: Residential unit load about 80-120 W/m², offices 120-180 W/m², and with dense equipment or west sun it can exceed 200 W/m²
map.新风负荷按换气次数估算，人员密集或气密性差的房间应提高换气次数: Fresh air load estimated by air change rate; rooms with dense occupancy or poor airtightness should use a higher air change rate
map.选型应留 10~15% 余量但不宜过大，否则频繁启停、能耗升高: Leave a 10-15% margin when selecting, but not too much, or the unit cycles frequently and energy use rises
map.西晒/顶层/大面积玻璃房应额外修正围护负荷: West sun, top floor and large glazed rooms need extra envelope load correction
map.单位负荷 188.8W/m² 偏高吗？: Is a unit load of 188.8 W/m² high?
map.住宅通常 80~120W/m²，办公室 120~180W/m²，设备密集或西晒房: Residential is usually 80-120 W/m², offices 120-180 W/m², and rooms with dense equipment or west sun can exceed 200 W/m². This example runs high because of 1000 W of equipment and 5 occupants; reducing simultaneous equipment use or moving to a north-facing room cuts it markedly.
map.为什么新风负荷按换气次数算？: Why is fresh air load computed from air changes?
map.新风负荷 = 换气量×空气密度×焓差，工具简化为 体积×1.5 次/h×3.5k: Fresh air load = air change volume × air density × enthalpy difference; the tool simplifies to volume × 1.5 times/h × 3.5 kJ/m³ ÷ 3.6 to get watts; rooms with dense occupancy or poor airtightness should use a higher air change rate.
